title: Can The Heroes Win Alone?
paragraphs: “W-What?”
Father reacted to the disturbance inside the Spirit Tortoise. But soon, it quieted down with a heavy *thud*. However, the rumbling noise kept resuming and stopping repeatedly.
“Has the Spirit Tortoise started moving?”
“Maybe it stopped playing dead because the path to the heart has opened?”
“That might be it. So, we can assume that Ren, Itsuki, and the Queen are taking care of the head, and it’s regenerating repeatedly.”
I think that’s almost certainly the case. In other words, this means we’ve made significant progress. The Spirit Tortoise is cornered and fighting desperately.
“Let’s move quickly.”
“Yes! We need to finish this quickly so I can watch Yuki-chan’s race!”
“Motoyasu-kun, you’re as enthusiastic as ever. But yeah, even though I’m not Motoyasu-kun, let’s all do our best so we can watch Yuki-chan’s big moment like nothing happened.”
Father gave a wry smile and agreed.

Alright! Let’s finish off the Spirit Tortoise quickly. We couldn’t take it down last time, but this time Ren and Itsuki are helping us. With our current lineup, I’m confident we could win even if all four of the sacred beasts were unsealed at once. That’s how solid our formation is. As we descended the shaking cave’s stairs, the surroundings gradually transformed into walls of raw flesh. The bulging blood vessels were pretty grotesque.
“What is this?”
Father pointed at a red vein growing along the path.
“I don’t know. Should I try cutting it?”
“It looks dangerous to touch it carelessly… but let’s give it a try. Meteor Shield!”
Father generated a barrier to protect everyone and then signaled me. I cut the red vein. As a result, cracks ran through the nearby flesh wall, revealing a new path.
“Ah… I see. So that’s how this gimmick works. And there’s even a blue vein too. Cutting it seems to call the monsters.”

Father seemed to have figured it out. I also vaguely understood based on the few games I’ve played. Basically, we need to use the red and blue veins to pave the way to the heart. And it comes with an alarm system. There are various types of the Spirit Tortoise’s familiars. Come to think of it, I remember seeing some of these materials in the items Father gave me.
“For now, this feels like a game strategy, but let’s just follow the path and work with the gimmicks.”
“Understood!”
“This is such a hassle, nano!”
“Hmm?”
“Naofumi-chan, wait a minute.”
The older sister called out to Father.
“What is it, Sadina-san?”
“Let me try something.”

The older sister touched the flesh wall and cast a lightning spell on the red and blue veins. A crackling sound echoed as electricity surged through both veins. With a hissing sound… the gimmick involving the two veins was silenced.
“Oh…”
“I think I can handle thin walls.”
“Amazing, but… well, we don’t have time to enjoy this. Sadina-san, could you take care of the gimmicks if we encounter any?”
“Leave it to me.”
As expected of the older sister that even Filo-tan relies on.
“I can do something similar too. I’ll blast through the flesh walls with high-density magic!”
“Well, yeah… but with this lineup, we should be able to get to the heart without any problems.”

And so, with the help of the older sister, we moved toward the heart. Of course, along the way, we fought countless Spirit Tortoise familiars. I feel like I’ve seen similar monsters in *Emerald Online*. It was probably inside the body of some other gigantic creature… though the structure was different. They were familiars that resembled white blood cells and red blood cells, or rather, they felt more like cell-type monsters.
“Th-There’s a humanoid familiar coming out of the wall—”
“Brionac! Take this!”
Without needing to check, I blasted the humanoid-looking familiar away!
“W-Well, let’s keep moving.”

With that, we headed toward what seemed to be the innermost part of the body dungeon. We discovered something that looked like a heart. In front of it, there was something that resembled a blue dragon hourglass.
“A blue dragon hourglass?”
“There was something like this when we fought the Phoenix.”

I remember seeing one standing in the square of the nation where the Phoenix was sealed. The amount of sand seems considerably less. I recall that last time, there was quite a lot of sand in it. I explained this to Father.
“Maybe… it’s displaying the amount of souls needed to maintain the barrier?”
“That’s probably it.”
“Either way, it destroyed an entire country in a single day. We should take it down quickly.”
“Indeed!”

The sounds of battle can be heard from outside. Well, Ren and Itsuki are strong, so all I hear is the occasional heavy *thud*. Compared to the pounding sound I hear when I think of Filo-tan, the Spirit Tortoise’s heartbeat sounded slightly cheaper, as if expressing its desperation. It’s an eerie heart with eyeballs. If we crush that at the right moment, victory is ours. Definitely. The reason crushing it like in the first world didn’t work last time was, as Father and the others deduced, because the other four spirits had already revived.
“Alright… the outer layer was disappointingly easy, but that doesn’t mean the heart will be weak. Motoyasu-kun, can I ask you to take the lead?”
“Understood!”
Father nodded at my response and began chanting a spell.
“Liberation Aura X!”
Receiving Father’s support magic, I focused my attention on the Spirit Tortoise’s heart.
“Here I go! Meteor Spear X!”
Following Itsuki’s example, I unleashed Meteor Spear as a form of suppression. Of course, I timed it to coincide with the sound of the Spirit Tortoise collapsing.
The heart of the Spirit Tortoise showed a look of surprise at the sudden ambush, but then it burst apart as my Meteor Spear hit it.
“Oh! Just like with the head, it was blown away so easily!”
“I matched the timing.”
I anticipated that Ren and Itsuki were probably fighting outside, so I timed the attack with the tremor that suggested they had taken off the head, and I blew the heart away.
“If it’s this easy, what’s the point of Gaelion and the others being here?”
“The heroes alone are enough to win…”
Rival and the assistant voiced their dissatisfaction.
“No, it was just too easy this time. Gradually, it’ll become harder for the heroes alone to manage…”
Father explained with a cold sweat. That’s true. In fact, during the previous loop, we couldn’t even come close to cornering the four spirits without the help of many allies.
Is it really necessary to worry about Rival’s complaints?
“At this level of strength, Gaelion and the others could probably handle it themselves.”
“There’s no need to bother Naofumi!”
“Better safe than sorry, right? Naofumi-chan. So, if what Motoyasu-chan said is true, this should be the end, right? I’m relieved.”
“If Motoyasu-kun’s knowledge is correct, then the Spirit Tortoise should be defeated… but…”
Father looked uneasily at the location where the heart had been.

Indeed… something feels off. At this point, the Spirit Tortoise should be dead, and the countdown for the next spirit, the Phoenix, should appear. Yet the hourglass still shows seven. Eventually, the heart started regenerating.
“Something’s wrong… I can’t believe Father’s story from the first world was mistaken.”
Even though I only heard it secondhand, the method Father discovered should have been enough to defeat it.
“If Motoyasu-kun’s knowledge had been wrong, I wouldn’t have been able to save myself when I was falsely accused. But… for some reason, we can’t defeat the Spirit Tortoise. What should we do?”

Father was wracking his brain for a solution. I’m sure he’ll come up with a brilliant idea soon. In the meantime, I kept blasting away at the regenerating heart to buy him more time. The heart’s regeneration is slow. Compared to the head that Ren and Itsuki are fighting outside, the regeneration cycle here is much slower.
“This is a hassle. Should I just blow away the entire inside of the Spirit Tortoise with magic?”

If I unleash Liberation Prominence at full power inside, wouldn’t I be able to incinerate all its internal organs? Even if there are other conditions, I’m sure I can vaporize the Spirit Tortoise itself.
